---
name: I tried it on some music
about: Tell us what you wanted to change, where it got stuck, and what you heard.
title: "Trial: "
labels: needs-triage
---

<!--
Three questions, all optional. A sentence each is plenty — vague, honest
reactions are exactly what this is for. "It sounded crowded" is a good answer.
-->

**What did you want to change?**
The piece or passage, and what you didn't like about it.

**Where did it get stuck?**
The step — installing, setting up playback, your agent reading the file,
writing the edit, reading the diff, hearing it — and what happened instead.
If your agent said something confusing about `mid`, paste it.

**What did you hear?**
After the change, did it sound better, worse, or just different? Did the
result match what the diff said?

<!-- If you can: `mid --version`, your OS, and which agent you used. -->
